# Reader Blog

> Technical articles about web data extraction, AI agents, and building with Reader -- the open-source web infrastructure platform for AI.

Reader is an open-source (Apache 2.0) web scraping platform that converts any webpage into clean, LLM-ready markdown.

## Core Primitives

- Read: Convert any URL to clean markdown
- Crawl: BFS crawl entire websites to markdown
- Browse: CDP cloud browser sessions for agents
- Extract: Structured data extraction with LLMs (coming soon)

## Key Links

- Website: https://reader.dev
- Documentation: https://docs.reader.dev

- RSS Feed: https://reader.dev/blog/rss.xml
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vakra-dev/reader
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/reader-py/

## Blog Categories

- Comparisons: Head-to-head comparisons of web scraping tools and platforms
- Tutorials: Step-by-step guides for web scraping and building with Reader
- Roundups: Curated lists of the best tools for web data extraction and AI
- Use Cases: Real-world applications of web scraping
- Deep Dives: Technical explorations of browser automation and anti-bot detection
- Thought Leadership: Perspectives on the future of web scraping and AI
- Ecosystem: Integration guides for LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, MCP
- Product: Feature deep-dives and engineering behind Reader

## SDKs

- JavaScript: @vakra-dev/reader-js (npm)
- Python: reader-py (PyPI)
- CLI: @vakra-dev/reader-cli (npm)

## Technology

- Engine: Playwright with fingerprint-generator for stealth browsing
- Markdown: Supermarkdown (Rust HTML-to-markdown engine with NAPI bindings)
- Deployment: Self-hosted (Docker) or managed API
